html:
G'oya

"Barcha tariflar, abonenti bo'lmasa ham" degan talab tariffs dan boshlanadigan LEFT JOIN ni anglatadi. Faol abonentlar sharti ON ichiga yoziladi: shunda bloklangan abonent ulanmaydi, lekin tarifning o'zi baribir qoladi.

Yechim

SELECT t.name AS tariff,
       COUNT(s.id) AS subscribers,
       COUNT(s.id) * t.monthly_fee AS revenue
FROM tariffs t
LEFT JOIN subscribers s ON s.tariff_id = t.id AND s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.monthly_fee
ORDER BY revenue DESC, tariff

COUNT(s.id) faqat haqiqatan ulangan abonentlarni sanaydi. Abonenti yo'q tarifda LEFT JOIN bitta qator qoldiradi, unda s.id NULL, va son 0 chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

WHERE s.status = 'active' sharti LEFT JOIN ni oddiy JOIN ga aylantiradi. Ulanmagan tariflarda s.status NULL, NULL = 'active' esa rost emas. Namunada Biznes (faqat bloklangan Dilnoza) va Oila (abonentsiz) yo'qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT t.name AS tariff,
       COUNT(s.id) AS subscribers,
       COUNT(s.id) * t.monthly_fee AS revenue
FROM tariffs t
LEFT JOIN subscribers s ON s.tariff_id = t.id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.monthly_fee
ORDER BY revenue DESC, tariff

COUNT(*) ham xato: u guruhdagi qatorlarni sanaydi, LEFT JOIN dan keyin esa bo'sh tarifda ham bitta qator bor. Oila 1 abonent va 80 000 so'm bo'lib chiqadi.

Daromadni SUM(t.monthly_fee) bilan hisoblasangiz, bo'sh tarifda NULL chiqadi. Kamayish tartibida NULL PostgreSQL'da birinchi, SQLite'da oxirgi o'rinda turadi.
